_about: Every public-domain George Whitefield (1714-1770) text the Word Hoard holds. The Works (London, 1771-1772, 6 vols: sermons, tracts and letters) are held clean from Gutenberg, rights lines checked by the fetcher. CCEL's Selected Sermons (1904, ed. A. R. Buckland) is held clean. The Journals survive on IA only in their first printings (1738-1756), raw OCR of 18th-century type: expect long-s errors. Not G. W. (George Whitefield) Samson or other namesakes.
